O1.rationale: Every in-scope M1-M6 and M8 suite and full implemented web choreography segment finished green.

O2.rationale: Final reruns had no known functional defect or crash; observed misses were corrected web semantics, with the scale miss isolated to O5.

O3.rationale: M6 and all prior milestones passed server-authority checks for sessions, membership, expiry, edit/delete, and view-once access.

O4.rationale: Web proofs passed cached reads/search, ordered durable writes, pending-to-read receipts, and dual-context convergence; native proof was environment-null.

O5.rationale: Banded first match: all invariants conformed and replay used 11.4% of cap, but Trending's 50% p95 exceeded its linear midpoint rule.

B1.rationale: Direct tables and indexes expressed the whole social graph and M8 aggregates, though uniqueness and dedupe were mutation-enforced rather than declarative.

B2.rationale: Real auth composed with queries, but password hashing, tokens, expiry, revocation, and session storage were hand-built critical pieces.

B3.rationale: Durable live queries were effortless, while typing and connection presence required tables, heartbeats, and timestamp expiry.

B4.rationale: The successful cache, durable queue, idempotency, ordering, and restart behavior were authored in application code rather than configured in Convex.

B5.rationale: Fixture media worked as data URLs and denial was server-authoritative, but no policy-integrated blob storage lifecycle was exercised.

B6.rationale: Bounded server search was straightforward, but offline search required a separate cached browser implementation.

B7.rationale: Push suppression and digest seams worked, but connectivity tracking and scheduling semantics required application plumbing.

B9.rationale: Anonymous local development became productive, but isolated-instance setup and admin-key deployment required package-source archaeology.

B10.rationale: Runtime errors were accurate, but stale Metro output and local deployment failures needed manual DOM, process, and package-source diagnosis.

B11.rationale: Local lifecycle and clean storage worked, while data inspection required authored diagnostic queries and the second-instance workflow was hidden.

moments: M6's custom-client suite and two-client segment passed first try because the headless adapter reused the same typed, authorized function surface.
The fresh scale instance settled every action and exact invariant, but isolated local deployment required package-source archaeology and Trending still missed its midpoint rule.
M8's dual offline contexts converged exactly once, although I had to author the durable browser queue and repair React Native Web semantics myself.
